## OpenRamble 0.34.1

**Faster microphone start after the app has been idle**

When macOS had moved OpenRamble out of memory, the first press of the dictation key started the microphone late. The app now keeps the microphone set up between dictations, so a press only has to start it.

In our tests, with memory full and every core busy:

| | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Typical start (median) | 136 ms | 87 ms |
| Slowest start | 315 ms | 148 ms |

The microphone still does not run between dictations. It is only set up in advance, and it starts when you press the key.
